I've been coming here for dental work for a long time because I used to work in the building next door, so it was convenient to walk. But what I love most is the teeth cleaning; it's no longer scary! The dentist is very gentle. They constantly ask how I'm doing, if it hurts, and tell me if it's painful or sensitive. If I can tolerate it, they'll continue; if not, they'll ask if I want a local anesthetic. I get everything done here related to teeth (except braces, because I don't know if the dentist does orthodontics, haha). Oh, and I don't think they do wisdom tooth extractions or other tooth extractions, so you'll have to go elsewhere. But for basic dental work like teeth cleaning and fillings, I highly recommend this place. Even after leaving my job to become a housewife in Samut Sakhon province, I still come here for dental work because it's so good I wouldn't dare go anywhere else. But if you want to come in for dental work, I recommend making an appointment in advance. Or if you really can't wait, you can call the nurses to ask about availability or schedule an appointment for the earliest possible date.
~There's parking for 2-3 cars in front of the clinic.
~There's seating for 2-4 people waiting inside the clinic.
~The place is clean and not crowded.
~The shop is located right by the road, just a short distance in, very easy to find. It's on the left-hand side.
~Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 5:00-6:00 PM (I think, but not sure because I've never been there close to closing time).
~Phone number: 02-681-2348
